hq_source: FDD Item 1, p6 — franchisor principal office
description: Stretch Recovery Lounge is an assisted-stretching and athletic-recovery franchise founded in New Jersey in 2019. Its studios offer one-on-one practitioner-assisted stretching and recovery services to clients ages 5 and up, with a core clientele of adults ages 40 to 65. The franchisor, Stretch Recovery Lounge Franchising LLC, began offering franchises in January 2024 and operates company-owned studios in New Jersey and New York. The franchise model is a 400 to 1,500 sq ft facility with a protected 3-mile or 15,000-population territory, a $45,000 initial franchise fee, a 6% royalty, and an estimated initial investment of $97,950 to $170,950.
territoryDescription: 3 miles or a population of 15,000 persons, whichever is less. Non-exclusive system with franchisor carve-outs (FDD Item 12, pp34-36).
item12: 3 miles or 15,000 population, whichever is less (FDD Item 12, p34)
item20_reconciliation: FDD Item 20 (p58, as of 2024-12-31): 6 company-owned, 0 franchised. Official location finder (2026-09-12): 8 open locations. Net +2 since FDD date.
